definition_used: Select molecular features whose values vary smoothly and strongly along a continuous reference trajectory, then verify that those features reconstruct the reference trajectory geometry better than baselines of equal size.
assumptions: Full feature space provides the best available internal reference trajectory because no external ground-truth lineage is supplied.
annotated_age is an observed continuous transition variable and is used as biological orientation/validation, not as the only ranking criterion.
RPE protein imaging features are treated as molecular readouts analogous to single-cell protein/gene features.
non_negotiable_steps: derive reference trajectory from all features
score individual features for dynamic association with trajectory
compare trajectory preservation against random and high-variance baselines at equal feature counts
export feature-level scores and validation metrics
planned_fallbacks: If Scanpy DPT fails, use PCA+KNN graph geodesic pseudotime rooted at lowest annotated_age cell; if UMAP unavailable, use PCA/Isomap for visualization.
